evidence_quotes:
b. (All models except M1123 and “A2”
vehicles). Check all drivebelts tension
using belt tension gauge. Belt tension
should be 70 lbs (311 N) minimum. If
belt tension is not at least 70 lbs (311 N),
adjust drivebelts (paragraph 3-82). Tension
should not be greater than 110 lbs (489 N)
for new belts; old belts 95 lbs (422 N).
statements.reason: The PMCS procedure limits the stated tension range to models other than M1123 and “A2” vehicles.
statements.statement: The general PMCS drivebelt-tension range does not apply to M1123 vehicles.

statements.statement: Paragraph 3-82 specifies tension checks and adjustments for models other than M1123 and “A2” vehicles; M1123 vehicles are excluded.

statements.reason: The supplied passages do not cite paragraph 11-202; the reference information cites paragraph 3-83 for replacing worn belts on M1123 vehicles.
